blocks.text: You will hear someone giving a talk. For each question, fill in the missing information in the numbered space. Write ONE WORD and / or A NUMBER for each answer.

blocks.title: NEW SCHOOL LIBRARY
lines: The name of the new librarian: 9__________ Smith.
Price: 10__________, there is small fee if you want to read at home.
Book types: school subject books, 11__________, hobby books
You can take up to 12__________ books at a time. And you’ll pay a 13__________ if don’t bring them back within three weeks.

blocks.text: You will hear people speaking in different situations. Match each speaker (15-18) to the place they met their best friend(A-F). There are TWO EXTRA options which you do not need to use. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.
You will hear someone giving a talk. Label the places (19-23) on the map (A-H). There are THREE extra options which you do not need to use. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.
You will hear three extracts. Choose the correct answer (A, B or C) for each question (24-29). There are TWO questions for each extract. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.

Extract One
*You hear two friends talking about an incident one of them has seen.*

items.q: What happened to the woman's car?
options: A) It was slightly scratched when a lorry reversed.
B) It was completely destroyed when a lorry drove over it.
C) It escaped damage when a lorry turned round.

items.q: How did the woman react to what had happened?
options: A) She was disappointed about missing her day out.
B) She felt some sympathy for the lorry driver.
C) She was extremely angry with the lorry driver.

blocks.text:
Extract Two
*On the radio, you hear a zoo director talking about the orangutans at the zoo.*

items.q: How did visitors at the zoo react to Marla's escape?
options: A) They were curious and crowded round to watch Marla.
B) They were worried about Marla and offered her food.
C) They were frightened because Marla seemed threatening.

items.q: Which of Marla's actions does the zoo director find particularly clever?
options: A) managing to hide some keys
B) using sign cards in an appropriate way
C) understanding why the vet had arrived

blocks.text:
Extract Three
*On the radio, you hear two people talking about a stonemason.*

items.q: What was the stonemason's initial response to the people around him?
options: A) He felt stopping work to speak to them was a waste of time.
B) He seemed to be completely unaware of their presence.
C) He was very willing to describe his skills and techniques.

items.q: Why were the onlookers so fascinated by the stonemason's work?
options: A) They believed his work had made him famous.
B) They valued craft work because it had become fashionable.
C) They found the idea of practical work appealing
